scope: Eighty-five distinct base-paper sites in the example/for-example family: 31 spaced adverb phrases and 54 noncanonical noun/adverb tokens.
choice: Normalize adverbial na primjer, na priměr and na primer to napriměr; normalize standalone naprimer to napriměr; normalize the Croatian-reflex primjer noun paradigm to official priměr with its existing inflection.
motivation: All sites denote an example or introduce an example. Official type-1 entries are priměr and napriměr, and the complete closure removes both the Croatian ije reflex and unaccented/spaced adverb variants.
alternatives_rejected: The initial 77-site audit was not accepted because it omitted seven na primer phrases and one standalone naprimer token from the same semantic family.
Retaining mixed spaced adverbs would preserve an artificial surface split without a meaning distinction.
Changing the distinct kontrapriměr compound or unrelated priklad/prěklad and priměnjenje families was rejected.

evidence.official_dictionary: Official dictionary id 3590 gives priměr, masculine type 1, example; id 28131 gives napriměr, adverb type 1, for example/for instance.
evidence.german_alignment: The German authority distinguishes illustrative Beispiel nouns and beispielsweise/zum Beispiel adverbials; every mapped site belongs to one of these two classes.
evidence.semantic_partition: Thirty-one adverb phrases plus one standalone unaccented adverb; 44 nominative/accusative nouns, four dative/locative singular, two instrumental singular, two dative plural and one genitive plural.
evidence.protected_domains: No target occurs in a comment, foreign-language argument, citation title, URL, proper name, label/reference or TeX control name.

validation.coverage: Exact phrase histogram 21 na primjer, three na priměr and seven na primer; after phrase replacement the exact token histogram is one naprimer, five Primjer, 39 primjer, four primjeru, two primjerom, two primjeram and one primjerov.
validation.failed_dry_run: The first dry-run rejected the incomplete 77-site postcondition before any write; the exact eight omitted family members were then added and the full successor re-derived.
validation.postcondition: All spaced example adverbs, naprimer and the complete primjer paradigm are zero; napriměr totals 49 and accented priměr noun forms total 124; kontrapriměr remains two.
validation.structure: Line counts, braces, ordered TeX controls and math delimiters are invariant; all non-base components are byte-identical.
validation.reproducibility: The expanded frozen successor hashes reproduced twice before atomic application and matched after application.
